title: Partition Labels
summary: Cut a string into as many pieces as possible so that every letter appears in only one piece, and return the piece sizes.

tests.explain: "aba" holds every a and b, "cdcd" holds every c and d, and the e at the end is alone. Any other cut would split some letter across two pieces.
The x at both ends forces the whole string into a single piece.
No letter repeats, so every letter can be its own piece.

hints: The first piece must contain the first letter, and therefore its last occurrence too. And every letter in between drags in its own last occurrence.
Precompute the last index of every letter. Then scan, stretching end = max(end, last[s[i]]).
When i reaches end, nothing inside the current piece appears later: close the piece (its size is end - start + 1) and start the next one at i + 1.

complexity.time: O(n): two passes over the string
